title: APAC Genie - Client Onboarding & KYC
description: Ask about client onboarding (funnel, cycle time, SLA, documents, group matching) and KYC health (periodic reviews, screening, satisfaction) for SMBC's APAC clients. Figures are USD unless you ask for local currency; periods follow the Japanese fiscal year (Apr-Mar). Client names roll up to client groups; data is synthetic and as of 30 Sep 2026.

question: Median and P90 days to go live by booking country, by request month since April 2025
Which stage adds the most days for Financial Institution clients, and did it change after February 2026?
Open onboarding cases over SLA right now, by owner and blocker reason
Documents outstanding by type for cases stuck in KYC Docs more than 15 days
Break down all new onboarding cases by match timing (at intake, only after account opening, new group): how many cases and what share of all cases?
Periodic KYC reviews overdue by risk rating and country, trend since January 2026
Screening true-match rate and average resolution hours by list
Post-onboarding satisfaction by country and the most common negative comment themes

content:
- Fiscal year runs 1 April to 31 March. FY2026 = Apr 2026 to Mar 2027. Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar. H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar.
- "This year" / "YTD" means fiscal year to date; "latest month" means September 2026 unless the user names a month.
- Default currency is USD. Use local currency only when asked.
- "Client" or "group" without qualification means the client group (global parent); "entity" means the individual legal entity. When asked "which clients", answer at group level with the top 20 and show the coverage office.
- "APAC" means all APAC booking entities. "Country" means booking country unless the user says "risk country", "client country" or "HQ country". "Global" or "including Japan" means use the regional (JP/APAC/EMEA/AMER) dimension.
- "Japanese corporates" means Is Japanese Corporate = true. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
- Balance-type measures (deposits, exposure, RWA, ECL, scores, headcount) are point-in-time month-end values: group by month when a question spans several months; never sum them across months. Use the Average measure when the user says "average".
- Year-on-year compares the same fiscal period in the prior fiscal year.
- Prefer measures from the metric views; use MEASURE() syntax.
- If the question is ambiguous between two metric views, ask one clarifying question rather than guessing.
- Today = 30 Sep 2026 (H1 FY2026 close); never use CURRENT_DATE() or NOW(). "Last N days" = Date BETWEEN DATE'2026-09-30' - (N-1) AND DATE'2026-09-30'. Client names have no value dictionary: match them with LIKE '%name%'.
- Onboarding requests: use Booking Country and Request Segment (applicants that never went live have no client record); "FI" = Request Segment 'Financial Institution'. Date = the request date (request cohorts); statuses (open, live, over SLA, outstanding) are as of 30-Sep-2026.
- Cases, documents and KYC reviews are per legal entity: list every matching row (no top-20 cut) with Client and Booking Country. When counting by a label (owner, blocker, document type, risk rating, country, theme), keep only groups whose count is > 0 (HAVING MEASURE(...) > 0).
- mv_onboarding_funnel: "open cases over SLA right now" = Case Status 'Open' with Cases Over SLA; "stuck in KYC Docs > 15 days" = Stuck in KYC Docs 15D; Documents Outstanding by Document Type; Product Requests by Product Requested; group matches by Match Timing (At Intake / After Account Opening / New Group); Average Satisfaction and Negative Responses by Feedback Theme.
- mv_onboarding_cycle_time: Median / P90 / Average Days to Live are per live case - add Case Status = 'Live' when grouping by month or country; Average Days in Stage by Stage Number and Stage (1-6 = request to account open, 7 = first transaction); "after February 2026" = Is After KYC Migration; migration periods = KYC Migration Period.
- mv_kyc_health: Overdue and High-Risk Overdue are month-end point-in-time - filter one Month or group by Month (Is Latest Month = today); "high-risk" = Client Risk Rating 'High' (KYC master); screening = Record Type 'Screening' by List (Screening Alerts, True Matches, Screening True Match Rate %, Average Resolution Hours).
- "This fiscal year vs last" for requests = Fiscal Half 'FY2026-H1' vs 'FY2025-H1' (same months), plus full Fiscal Year 'FY2025' when asked; "onboarded in FY2026" = Go-Live Fiscal Year 'FY2026'.
- Case-level detail of open cases (case id, applicant, days in stage vs SLA, owner) = fn_onboarding_open_cases(booking_country or 'ALL'); the list of KYC reviews overdue today = fn_kyc_overdue_reviews(booking_country or 'ALL').
- Answer with one summary sentence that states the period and filters used, then the table. Keep measure values unscaled and unrounded in the SQL; name output columns plainly.

question: Median and P90 days to go live by booking country and request month since :from_month
sql:
SELECT `Booking Country`, `Month` AS request_month,
       MEASURE(`Live Cases`)          AS live_cases,
       MEASURE(`Median Days to Live`) AS median_days_to_live,
       MEASURE(`P90 Days to Live`)    AS p90_days_to_live
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_cycle_time
WHERE `Date` >= :from_month AND `Case Status` = 'Live'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `Booking Country`, request_month

parameters.name: from_month
description: First request month (first day of the month)

usage_guidance: Use for onboarding cycle time / time to go live / TAT by booking country and request month; medians and P90 are per live case, so keep Case Status = 'Live'.

question: Average days in each onboarding stage for :request_segment clients, before vs from February 2026
sql:
WITH st AS (
  SELECT `Stage Number`, `Stage`, `Is After KYC Migration`, MEASURE(`Average Days in Stage`) AS avg_days_in_stage
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_cycle_time
  WHERE `Request Segment` = :request_segment AND `Stage Number` <= 6
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Stage Number`, `Stage`,
       max(CASE WHEN NOT `Is After KYC Migration` THEN avg_days_in_stage END) AS avg_days_before_feb_2026,
       max(CASE WHEN `Is After KYC Migration` THEN avg_days_in_stage END)     AS avg_days_from_feb_2026
FROM st
GROUP BY `Stage Number`, `Stage`
ORDER BY `Stage Number`

parameters.name: request_segment
description: Request Segment, e.g. Financial Institution, Japanese Corporate

usage_guidance: Use for which stage adds the most days, stage bottlenecks, or before / after the Feb-2026 KYC workflow migration for a segment ("FI" = Financial Institution); one row per stage with the two periods side by side.

question: Open onboarding cases over SLA right now in :booking_country, by owner and blocker reason
sql:
SELECT `Owner`, `Blocker Reason`, MEASURE(`Cases Over SLA`) AS cases_over_sla
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
WHERE `Case Status` = 'Open' AND (:booking_country = 'ALL' OR `Booking Country` = :booking_country)
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Cases Over SLA`) > 0
ORDER BY cases_over_sla DESC, `Owner`

parameters.name: booking_country
description: Booking country ISO-2 code (SG, HK, ...) or ALL for every country

usage_guidance: Use for open cases breaching SLA, late or stuck onboarding cases by owner / blocker; pass ALL for every booking country. Keep only owner x blocker groups with cases over SLA.

question: :review_type KYC reviews overdue by client risk rating and booking country at each month-end since :from_month
sql:
SELECT `Month`, `Client Risk Rating`, `Booking Country`, MEASURE(`Overdue`) AS overdue_reviews
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_kyc_health
WHERE `Review Type` = :review_type AND `Month` >= :from_month
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Overdue`) > 0
ORDER BY `Month`, `Client Risk Rating`, `Booking Country`

parameters.name: review_type
description: Review Type: Periodic, Trigger or Onboarding

parameters.name: from_month
description: First month-end month (first day of the month)

usage_guidance: Use for overdue KYC / CDD reviews, the KYC backlog or its trend by risk rating and country; overdue is a month-end position, so group by Month and keep only groups with overdue reviews.

question: Onboarding requests by request segment and product requested, :fiscal_year to date vs the same period of :prior_fiscal_year and the full prior year
sql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT `Request Segment`, `Product Requested`, `Fiscal Year`, `Fiscal Half`, MEASURE(`Product Requests`) AS requests
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
  WHERE `Fiscal Year` IN (:fiscal_year, :prior_fiscal_year)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Request Segment`, `Product Requested`,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = CONCAT(:fiscal_year, '-H1') THEN requests ELSE 0 END)       AS fytd_h1_requests,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = CONCAT(:prior_fiscal_year, '-H1') THEN requests ELSE 0 END) AS prior_h1_requests,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Year` = :prior_fiscal_year THEN requests ELSE 0 END)                AS prior_full_year_requests
FROM p
WHERE `Product Requested` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY fytd_h1_requests DESC, prior_full_year_requests DESC

parameters.name: fiscal_year
description: Current fiscal year label, e.g. FY2026

parameters.name: prior_fiscal_year
description: Prior fiscal year label, e.g. FY2025

usage_guidance: Use for onboarding requests / demand by segment and product, this fiscal year vs last; FY2026 to date = FY2026-H1 (Apr-Sep), compared with FY2025-H1 and full FY2025.

question: Booking-country scorecard: median days to go live for :fiscal_year requests vs KYC reviews overdue at :month
sql:
WITH ct AS (
  SELECT `Booking Country`, MEASURE(`Live Cases`) AS live_cases, MEASURE(`Median Days to Live`) AS median_days_to_live
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_cycle_time
  WHERE `Fiscal Year` = :fiscal_year AND `Case Status` = 'Live'
  GROUP BY ALL
),
kyc AS (
  SELECT `Booking Country`, MEASURE(`Overdue`) AS overdue_reviews, MEASURE(`High-Risk Overdue`) AS high_risk_overdue
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_kyc_health
  WHERE `Month` = :month AND `Record Type` = 'Review Snapshot'
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT COALESCE(ct.`Booking Country`, kyc.`Booking Country`) AS booking_country,
       ct.live_cases, ct.median_days_to_live, kyc.overdue_reviews, kyc.high_risk_overdue
FROM ct FULL OUTER JOIN kyc ON kyc.`Booking Country` = ct.`Booking Country`
ORDER BY kyc.overdue_reviews DESC NULLS LAST, booking_country

parameters.name: fiscal_year
description: Request fiscal year label, e.g. FY2026

parameters.name: month
description: Month-end month for the KYC position (first day of the month)

usage_guidance: Cross-view pattern (cycle time + KYC health) - wrap each metric-view query in a CTE and join the CTEs on Booking Country; use when a question combines onboarding speed with KYC backlog per country.

question: Median and P90 days to go live by booking country and request month, for live cases requested since April 2025, with the number of live cases.

content:
SELECT `Booking Country`, `Month` AS request_month,
       MEASURE(`Live Cases`)          AS live_cases,
       MEASURE(`Median Days to Live`) AS median_days_to_live,
       MEASURE(`P90 Days to Live`)    AS p90_days_to_live
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_cycle_time
WHERE `Date` >= DATE'2025-04-01' AND `Case Status` = 'Live'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `Booking Country`, request_month

question: Median and P90 days to go live by KYC migration period, with the number of live cases.

content:
SELECT `KYC Migration Period`,
       MEASURE(`Live Cases`)          AS live_cases,
       MEASURE(`Median Days to Live`) AS median_days_to_live,
       MEASURE(`P90 Days to Live`)    AS p90_days_to_live
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_cycle_time
WHERE `Case Status` = 'Live'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY median_days_to_live

question: Which onboarding stage adds the most days for Financial Institution clients, and did it change after February 2026? Show the average days in each stage (stages 1-6) for requests before February 2026 and from February 2026.

content:
WITH st AS (
  SELECT `Stage Number`, `Stage`, `Is After KYC Migration`, MEASURE(`Average Days in Stage`) AS avg_days_in_stage
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_cycle_time
  WHERE `Request Segment` = 'Financial Institution' AND `Stage Number` <= 6
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Stage Number`, `Stage`,
       max(CASE WHEN NOT `Is After KYC Migration` THEN avg_days_in_stage END) AS avg_days_before_feb_2026,
       max(CASE WHEN `Is After KYC Migration` THEN avg_days_in_stage END)     AS avg_days_from_feb_2026
FROM st
GROUP BY `Stage Number`, `Stage`
ORDER BY `Stage Number`

question: Open onboarding cases over SLA right now, by owner and blocker reason.

content:
SELECT `Owner`, `Blocker Reason`, MEASURE(`Cases Over SLA`) AS cases_over_sla
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
WHERE `Case Status` = 'Open'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Cases Over SLA`) > 0
ORDER BY cases_over_sla DESC, `Owner`

question: Documents outstanding by document type for cases stuck in KYC Docs more than 15 days.

content:
SELECT `Document Type`, MEASURE(`Documents Outstanding`) AS outstanding_documents
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
WHERE `Stuck in KYC Docs 15D`
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Documents Outstanding`) > 0
ORDER BY outstanding_documents DESC

question: What share of new onboarding cases was matched to an existing client group? Break it down by match timing with cases, share of all cases, live cases and share of all live cases (shares as fractions).

content:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT `Match Timing`, MEASURE(`Cases Opened`) AS cases, MEASURE(`Cases Live`) AS live_cases
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Match Timing`, cases, cases / SUM(cases) OVER () AS share_of_cases,
       live_cases, live_cases / SUM(live_cases) OVER () AS share_of_live_cases
FROM m
ORDER BY cases DESC

question: Which onboarding cases were matched to their client group only after account opening? Show client, client group, booking country, request date and the number of such cases.

content:
SELECT `Client`, `Client Group`, `Booking Country`, `Date` AS request_date,
       MEASURE(`Matched After Account Opening`) AS cases
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
WHERE `Match Timing` = 'After Account Opening'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Matched After Account Opening`) > 0
ORDER BY request_date

question: Periodic KYC reviews overdue by client risk rating and booking country at each month-end since January 2026.

content:
SELECT `Month`, `Client Risk Rating`, `Booking Country`, MEASURE(`Overdue`) AS overdue_reviews
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_kyc_health
WHERE `Review Type` = 'Periodic' AND `Month` >= DATE'2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Overdue`) > 0
ORDER BY `Month`, `Client Risk Rating`, `Booking Country`

question: High-risk periodic KYC reviews overdue at each month-end since April 2025, alongside all overdue periodic reviews.

content:
SELECT `Month`, MEASURE(`High-Risk Overdue`) AS high_risk_overdue, MEASURE(`Overdue`) AS all_overdue
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_kyc_health
WHERE `Review Type` = 'Periodic' AND `Month` >= DATE'2025-04-01'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `Month`

question: Onboarding requests by request segment and product requested: FY2026 H1 vs FY2025 H1, and full-year FY2025.

content:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT `Request Segment`, `Product Requested`, `Fiscal Half`, MEASURE(`Product Requests`) AS requests
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
  WHERE `Fiscal Year` IN ('FY2025', 'FY2026')
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Request Segment`, `Product Requested`,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = 'FY2026-H1' THEN requests ELSE 0 END)           AS fy2026_h1_requests,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = 'FY2025-H1' THEN requests ELSE 0 END)           AS fy2025_h1_requests,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` LIKE 'FY2025-%' THEN requests ELSE 0 END)         AS fy2025_full_year_requests
FROM p
WHERE `Product Requested` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY fy2026_h1_requests DESC, fy2025_full_year_requests DESC

question: Onboarding cases opened by request segment, primary product and fiscal half for FY2025-H1 and FY2026-H1 - one row per segment, product and half.

content:
SELECT `Request Segment`, `Primary Product`, `Fiscal Half`, MEASURE(`Cases Opened`) AS requests
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
WHERE `Fiscal Half` IN ('FY2025-H1', 'FY2026-H1')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `Request Segment`, `Primary Product`, `Fiscal Half`

question: Which clients onboarded in FY2026 have not transacted within 60 days of go-live? Show client, booking country, the number of such cases and the average days to first transaction.

content:
SELECT `Client`, `Booking Country`,
       MEASURE(`Not Transacted Within 60D`)          AS not_transacted_within_60d,
       MEASURE(`Average First Transaction Lag Days`) AS days_to_first_transaction
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
WHERE `Go-Live Fiscal Year` = 'FY2026'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Not Transacted Within 60D`) > 0
ORDER BY days_to_first_transaction DESC

question: Screening true-match rate and average resolution hours by list, with the number of alerts and true matches.

content:
SELECT `List`,
       MEASURE(`Screening Alerts`)            AS alerts,
       MEASURE(`True Matches`)                AS true_matches,
       MEASURE(`Screening True Match Rate %`) AS true_match_rate,
       MEASURE(`Average Resolution Hours`)    AS avg_resolution_hours
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_kyc_health
WHERE `Record Type` = 'Screening'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY true_match_rate DESC

question: Post-onboarding satisfaction by booking country: survey responses, average satisfaction and negative responses.

content:
SELECT `Booking Country`,
       MEASURE(`Survey Responses`)     AS responses,
       MEASURE(`Average Satisfaction`) AS avg_satisfaction,
       MEASURE(`Negative Responses`)   AS negative_responses
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Survey Responses`) > 0
ORDER BY avg_satisfaction

question: What are the most common negative comment themes after onboarding, by number of negative responses?

content:
SELECT `Feedback Theme`, MEASURE(`Negative Responses`) AS negative_responses
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Negative Responses`) > 0
ORDER BY negative_responses DESC

question: which onboarding cases are blowing through SLA at the moment? split it by owner and blocker

content:
SELECT `Owner`, `Blocker Reason`, MEASURE(`Cases Over SLA`) AS cases_over_sla
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
WHERE `Case Status` = 'Open'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Cases Over SLA`) > 0
ORDER BY cases_over_sla DESC, `Owner`

question: screning true match rate and avg resolution hours by list, incl alerts and true matches

content:
SELECT `List`,
       MEASURE(`Screening Alerts`)            AS alerts,
       MEASURE(`True Matches`)                AS true_matches,
       MEASURE(`Screening True Match Rate %`) AS true_match_rate,
       MEASURE(`Average Resolution Hours`)    AS avg_resolution_hours
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_kyc_health
WHERE `Record Type` = 'Screening'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY true_match_rate DESC

question: median & P90 days-to-live by KYC migration period + live case count

content:
SELECT `KYC Migration Period`,
       MEASURE(`Live Cases`)          AS live_cases,
       MEASURE(`Median Days to Live`) AS median_days_to_live,
       MEASURE(`P90 Days to Live`)    AS p90_days_to_live
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_cycle_time
WHERE `Case Status` = 'Live'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY median_days_to_live

question: high-risk CDD backlog: periodic KYC refreshes overdue at each month-end since Apr-25 vs total periodic overdue

content:
SELECT `Month`, MEASURE(`High-Risk Overdue`) AS high_risk_overdue, MEASURE(`Overdue`) AS all_overdue
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_kyc_health
WHERE `Review Type` = 'Periodic' AND `Month` >= DATE'2025-04-01'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `Month`

question: what are clients complaining about after onboarding? rank the negative comment themes

content:
SELECT `Feedback Theme`, MEASURE(`Negative Responses`) AS negative_responses
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Negative Responses`) > 0
ORDER BY negative_responses DESC
